sources.articleTitle: Indian Railways to connect Nepal’s Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya through weekly train service
Railways approves weekly train service connecting Nepal's Janakpur Dham with Ayodhya

headline: Indian Railways Approves New Weekly Train Route To Ayodhya And Nepal
seoTitle: New Weekly Train Link Between Ayodhya And Janakpur
metaDescription: Indian Railways has announced a new weekly train service connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal with the city of Ayodhya to enhance cross-border travel.
aiSummaryBullets: A new weekly train route connecting Janakpur Dham in Nepal to Ayodhya has received official approval.
The service will feature multiple scheduled stops, including Jaynagar, Sitamarhi, and Gorakhpur.
The route aims to establish a direct rail link between these two significant cultural locations.
aiContextParagraph: Indian Railways has officially authorized the launch of a weekly train service designed to facilitate travel between Janakpur Dham in Nepal and the city of Ayodhya in India. This new connection is intended to provide a direct transit corridor for passengers traveling between these destinations. According to reports from national media outlets, the train route will include several intermediate stations to serve regional commuters. Specifically, the itinerary incorporates stops at Jaynagar, Madhubani, Shisho, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, Gorakhpur, Basti, and Mankapur before reaching the terminal point at Ayodhya Dham. This development reflects an expansion of rail infrastructure intended to improve connectivity across the border, linking Nepal to major locations within India. The service is expected to operate on a weekly basis, though further details regarding the specific launch date and operational logistics remain to be determined by the railway authorities.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction through coverage in two national outlets, reflecting significant interest in regional infrastructure and cross-border connectivity.
